title: Records and equations for the unchanged ordinary finite adjunction
statement: Record the existing canonical finite-module derived adjunction [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], without changing the published pullback, pushforward, unit comparison or projective-line components. Proved equations identify the published components with those of the recorded adjunction. Direct image is additive. Normalized arrow pullback is the inverse constant comparison followed by inverse image of the arrow and the specified target comparison.

proof.text: Record the canonical finite-module derived adjunction directly, preserving the published functors. Derived direct image is additive by the existing additive-right-derived-functor instance. Define normalized arrow pullback by its explicit three-arrow composite. Expanding the new adjunction record proves the two equations for the unchanged published projective-line components.
